story.headline: A workable morning window with a careful weather watch
story.summary: Sample data shows a readable field board: tide rising, useful solunar windows, moderate wind watch, team check-ins and a growing media queue.
story.longform: This is not live weather or navigation advice. It shows how a future agent stream can turn scattered tide, solunar, weather, team and media points into a simple story the committee can review before, during and after a comp.
